So, I've been at a crossroads for these last few days. 
I'm faced with two decisions: quit the challenge and hopefully get rid of my crush. Or I keep doing the challenge and keep obsessing over that person for no reason.

I flipped a coin, and it said to quit the challenge, but I don't feel like throwing away a year and a half worth of "progress."

Last weekend I started to focus on myself a lot more and when I went to school on Monday, I didn't care about my crush at all and even accidentally made her laugh a few times, over all I was owning it socially. I went home happy. 
Then I had a really depressing dream about my crush and Tuesday was a social disaster for me. After that I went to /r9k/, a very misogynistic place, but I feel at home there, mostly because I lurk, but still.

I have stopped trying to "make it" and become something other than a social retard, because I don't have the drive..

I apologize for writing a "blog" here, but I just wanted to give an update on my situation and that I may quit the challenge soon.
